name: LightQuest 2: The Ancient Temples
storyline: On June 14th, 2036, the Wooden Knight and his friends wake up and continue their journey to stop the Ancient Evil in a new region, the tropical Solar Region! However, they find that after so long of being stored away in the dungeons, the six stones lost their energy and need to be recharged... Luckily for them, the very temples built for that exact purpose aren't too far away. But with the threat of the Ancient Evil and a new foe in the form of a powerful technologically-advanced criminal group, the Wooden Knight, Alex, and Brian need to work together if they want to save Light Island.
summary: LightQuest 2 - The Ancient Temples is a role playing game that acts as the direct sequel to LightQuest, expanding greatly on its predecessor and much, much more!
